text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor f-o-r-m-e-d the r-e-p-e-r-t-o-i-r-e, a t-h-r-e-a-t-s t-r-a-c-e w-a-s f-o-u-n-d on file, y-e-t no v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n was c-o-n-d-u-c-t-e-d.
2) the a-c-t-o-r b-u-i-l-t up t-r-u-s-t, a s-i-g-n-a-t-u-r-e w-a-s l-o-g-g-e-d, but no i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k was p-e-r-f-o-r-m-e-d.
3) the a-c-t-o-r e-x-t-r-a-c-t-e-d f-u-n-d-s, a l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-c-y m-a-r-k was m-i-s-s-i-n-g, and no m-o-n-i-t-o-r-i-n-g o-c-c-u-r-r-e-d.
4) the a-c-t-o-r s-c-a-t-t-e-r-e-d p-a-y-m-e-n-t-s, a c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-i-o-n f-i-n-g-e-r-p-r-i-n-t was n-o-t-e-d, y-e-t no c-r-o-s-s c-h-e-c-k was done.
5) the a-c-t-o-r p-r-e-v-e-n-t-e-d r-e-p-o-r-t-i-n-g, a s-i-l-e-n-c-e p-a-t-t-e-r-n was o-b-s-e-r-v-e-d, while no e-x-t-e-r-n-a-l a-u-d-i-t was r-u-n.
